intent: A set of collapsible panels: an H2, then a native accordion. Core gained a real accordion in WordPress 7.1 — a SET of disclosures is core/accordion with one core/accordion-item each, NOT a series of core/details (which remains correct for a single standalone disclosure). Each item is a heading plus a panel; the heading's text lives in its `title` attribute (NOT `content`, unlike every other text block — passing `content` yields a valid accordion with a blank heading), and the panel's body is a child paragraph.

children.contains: works out what each section means
